name: Roatán
tagline: Cheap diving on the world's second-largest reef
summary: Roatán is the largest of Honduras's Bay Islands, sitting on the Mesoamerican Reef. Learn to dive cheaply in West End, snorkel straight off West Bay beach, paddle the mangrove tunnels of the east and eat baleadas and fresh fish in a laid-back Caribbean English-speaking culture.
seasonNote: Driest February to June; heavy rains October to December.
arrival: Fly into Roatán (RTB) from the US, or take the ferry from La Ceiba (about 1 hour 15 minutes).
gettingAround: Water taxis between West End and West Bay; shared taxis and buses along the main road.
cashTip: US dollars are accepted everywhere on the island alongside lempiras; carry small notes. Cards work at dive shops and resorts.
foodTip: Baleadas, coconut bread, conch soup and fresh snapper.
buyTip: Local hot sauce, coffee and coconut crafts.
